item.title: Christopher Griffin Gets A Stern Talking To In 'Listen Up, Christopher' Meme
item.description: Listen Up, Christopher is a series of video edit memes where clips of Chris Griffin from Family Guy are interrupted by a deep voice over that says, "Listen up, Christopher Griffin," then proceeds to lecture Chris about what he did wrong in the clip. The memes were popularized in January 2026 on TikTok, along with a sister format, Nightmare Freddy Lectures, which similarly sees Nightmare Freddy from Five Nights at Freddy's interrupt video clips to scold a character for doing something wrong.
